items.name: ACT Championship 2021

venue.name: Canberra Girls Grammar School, Junior School

items.information:
## This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 lockdown
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2dQIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f944641bb33e595589096a7c8a821fe9da8bc708/State%20Cubes_ACT%20Championship%20small.png)

Please take the time to read the FAQ tab, even if you have previously competed. To ensure this is a COVID-safe environment, things will be done differently and there will be additional conditions in place.  

Please note there is strict density limit at the hall and there is a limit of ONE guest per competitor.

**If you feel sick, stay at home.** If you are exhibiting cold or flu-like symptoms consistent with COVID-19, you will **not** be permitted in the venue.  We are not responsible for any illness you may contract from the competition.

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

items.name: Beijing Summer 2021

venue.name: Dahongmen International Convention & Exhibition Center
venue.details: Multi purpose hall on 2F and 3F, Meihuayuan Building

items.information:
In accordance with relevant regulations on the prevention and control of the recent COVID-19 pandemic, the following emergency notice is hereby annouced.

# Beijing Summer 2021, the event planned to be held in Beijing from July 31st to August 1st, has been cancelled.

Regarding the refund of this competition and other atters, the organizing team will contact all the registered competitors by follow-up E-mails. Please be patient.

Thank you all for your attention and support to this event. We apologize for the inconvenience caused to you.

items.name: Wyoming Summer 2021

venue.name: [College Heights Baptist Church](https://www.collegeheightscasper.org/)
venue.details: Parking lots are south of the building. The competition is in the large sanctuary/gym on the east side of the building.

items.information:
# All persons entering the venue will be required to have proof of a negative COVID-19 test from up to 96 hours prior to the competition or proof of vaccination to enter the venue. If you have symptoms of COVID-19, please do not attend this competition. 
Be sure to familiarize yourself with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), the WCA [Competition Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), and our [Risk Management Plan for this competition](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1wMjYn8D3sdeKuGOvRS9HOcracspftxw6/view?usp=sharing).

Please read through the [Judging](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WyomingSummer2021#15768-judging) and [Competing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WyomingSummer2021#15771-competing) tabs before registering.

Competitors are advised to bring their own pens.

Most competitors will be expected to judge.

items.name: Empire State Summer A 2021
items.information:
This is a twin competition with [Empire State Summer B 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateSummerB2021). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Empire State Summer B 2021, your registration for this competition will be rejected.

**Competitors may bring at most one guest.**
